name: Amylase
overview: Amylase is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include an amylase is an enzyme that catalyses the hydrolysis of starch into sugars; amylase is present in the saliva of humans and some other mammals, where it begins the chemical process of digestion; foods that contain large amounts of starch but little sugar, such as rice and potatoes, may acquire a sweet taste as they are chewed because amylase degrades some of their starch into sugar. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
